title: The q-deformed weight $\widetilde{w}_\lambda$, and significance for mass-tower computations
html:
Remark. The q-deformed weight \widetilde{w}_\lambda, and significance for mass-tower computations

Remark (q-deformed alternative). The q-deformed weight \widetilde{w}_\lambda = \dim_q^2 V_\lambda / [n]_q! sums to a finite value \approx 1.51 rather than exactly 1. It does not construct a pure probability measure at generic q \neq 1. However, the Plancherel boundedness property neutralizes matrix-dimension divergences inside log-pairings, suppressing combinatorial scale factors into average bounds. Without this boundedness, the deep-tower calculations would mathematically diverge.
